author: Autodesk
description: A demonstration of edge damage by intersection method
documentation:
## Edge Damage Intersection

### What it does
This graph is a method for creating edge damage on convex geometry.

### Inputs and outputs
This graph is self-contained, the columns are generated in Bifrost, check out the ***make_column*** compound at the beginning of the graph for an example.  The output is the generated mesh, with broken up edges.

### How it works
The mesh is converted into a volume to make a higher-resolution version of the mesh.  The mesh is then inflated along its normals.  The inflated mesh is used to generate a mask based on the curvature of the mesh.  This tends to isolate edgess as areas of high curvature.  This mask is then used to displace the infalted mesh.  The inflated mesh is then used as an intersection in a boolean meshes.  This will chip the edges.

_notes.text:
# property proxy field

The curvature property setup earlier on this mesh (inside ***generate_curvature_mask***) is used as a multiplier on the displacement of the cutting mesh.  This will guarantee less displacement on flatter areas of the mesh.

***property_proxy_field*** is a compound that allows a *geo_property* to be used as field data.
Feel free to replace this with your own geo

# edge_damage_intersect

This graph is a method for creating edge damage on convex geometry.  Most of the look is driven by the settings on ***fractal_noise_field***.

The method is 
- make a higher res version
- Inflate the geometry along its normals
- displace the inflated version with a curvature based mask
- use the resulting mesh as an intersection boolean with the original mesh

The mesh is first converted to a volume then **expanded** and converted back into a mesh.

The method used for creating edge damage will involve an intersection between this mesh and the base mesh, so the expansion and resolution gain from this process is required.

_backdrops.title: Make a strand the height of the column
Find the cylinder points along that line, get the point ratio of the strand at those points
Remap the point ratio array to the input scale settings
Instance a capsule on the points of the strand
Cut the capsules from the cylinder

_notes.text:
# masking the flat areas

This graph is about damaging the edges of a complex object, so in this compound a mask is created based on the curvature of the points making up the expanded and higher resolution mesh.

This mask will be used later to avoid cutting into any large, flat areas.

***update_mesh_curvature*** is a custom compound that returns both the positive and negative curvature of the input, based on adjacent edges to a point.  This is stored on the mesh as a property to be retrieved later and used as a mask on the displacement field.

_backdrops.title: D I S T A N C E  S Q U A R E D

_notes.text:
Curvature is calculated using vertex-to-edge average - this gives a better result with tighter meshes and edges.

Based on:
<font size=2>https://www.stepanjirka.com/maya-api-curvature-shader/</font>
